_note: Eval source manifest. Source TEXTS are never committed (this repo is public) — fetch them into eval/.cache/ (gitignored). People/videos are drawn from llm-bento.com/people. `genre` and `stress` exist so the set covers different comprehension problems, not ten copies of one.

sources.title: Do Things That Don't Scale
sources.author: Paul Graham
sources.stress: anchor: the only source with prior decks (examples/dont-scale.deck.html, built on Opus 4.8) — cross-version reference

sources.title: Leverage Points: Places to Intervene in a System
sources.author: Donella Meadows
sources.stress: a ranked list of 12 mechanisms — tempts a bullet dump; begs for stocks/flows instruments

sources.title: Zoom In: An Introduction to Circuits
sources.author: Chris Olah et al.
sources.stress: the source is itself a world-class explorable — a high bar; text-only fetch loses its figures

sources.title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
sources.author: Alan Turing
sources.fetch_hint: the DOI may be paywalled — find an open full-text copy of the 1950 paper
sources.stress: nine objections-and-replies — structure-heavy, needs a navigable argument map

sources.title: Notes on the Analytical Engine (Note G)
sources.author: Ada Lovelace
sources.fetch_hint: use Note G (the Bernoulli-number program) plus enough of the surrounding notes for context
sources.stress: a step-by-step computation — the natural test for a stepper instrument; 1843 prose

sources.title: Facing Up to the Problem of Consciousness
sources.author: David Chalmers
sources.stress: purely conceptual, no numbers — tests whether instruments stay epistemic, not decorative

sources.title: Training a Misaligned Reward Seeker
sources.author: Evan Hubinger et al.
sources.stress: recent, after many models' training data; empirical results with figures

sources.title: Policy on the AI Exponential
sources.author: Dario Amodei
sources.stress: exponential reasoning — compound-growth instruments; persuasion vs comprehension

sources.title: On the Measure of Intelligence
sources.author: François Chollet
sources.fetch_hint: use the arXiv HTML or PDF full text
sources.stress: LONG source — compression under a slide budget; formal definitions

sources.title: How the Brain Shapes Reality — with Andy Clark
sources.author: Andy Clark (Royal Institution)
sources.stress: spoken, digressive, no headings — tests digest on unstructured speech

sources.title: The Potential for AI in Science and Mathematics
sources.author: Terence Tao
sources.stress: a mathematician speaking to a general audience; examples carry the argument
